title: Bots with their own instructions and tools, joining a channel over time
description: Ryan 11-02: the bot answering a Story's channel changes as the Story moves between sections, and each bot has a different context and different capabilities. Already there: one Pi session per bot per channel, per-bot memory, bots seeing each other's answers as attributed lines, a bot addressing another bot. Missing: (1) adding or removing a bot on an existing channel (fbc0d9 covers only people); (2) a bot joining late reads history from the channel record, chatticus-e4f1f2, and only its context from joining on is compacted into its session, say how; (3) per-bot instructions, since the Bot record holds only name and memory and buildSystemPrompt is fixed; (4) per-bot tools, since extensions come from the execution profile not the bot, tied to 4f6eda; (5) a channel's current responder, set by the host, so an address to 'the bot' goes to the right one. Unaddressed messages still start no turn. Done: Gherkin scenarios for a bot taking over a channel, the new bot answering with history, the earlier bot no longer answering, a bot returning, and two bots with different instructions and tools on one channel.
